memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks unaided, continues college lecturing, no assistance needed.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5, recall intact, clock drawing normal; no cognitive concerns.
falls: No falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds; fall risk normal.
medicines: 8 regular medicines (levetiracetam, lamotrigine, atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, fenofibrate, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol, montelukast); polypharmacy – please review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports good mood, enjoys teaching, denies sadness or anxiety.
carers: Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay independent and keep teaching my classes."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: FEV1 1.85 L (68% predicted), FVC 2.40 L (78% predicted), FEV1/FVC 77%; post-bronchodilator FEV1 2.05 L (75% predicted) – 12% improvement, consistent with asthma. No significant obstruction.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Pulmonology, Dr S. Rao, for asthma review and optimisation of inhaler therapy. Include recent spirometry and Asthma Control Test score.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonology review: Asthma well-controlled on current budesonide-formoterol and montelukast; continue salbutamol SOS. No change advised. Annual influenza vaccination recommended.
